title.narrative: Strengthening the HIV National Response with a Focus on Key Populations

description.narrative: Suriname - HIV - Ministry of Health of the Republic of Suriname - MOH. This program has the following goals: Accelerate prevention to reduce new HIV infections (NSP). Reduce morbidity and mortality by providing treatment, care and adherence support for KPs (NSP). Improve HIV resource acquisition and allocation (NSP). Strengthen program management and response to ensure equity, human rights and sustainability. Strengthen strategic information to guide progress towards elimination of AIDS (NSP). The objectives of this program are: Increase the number of KPs receiving prevention interventions. Increase the number of KPs who know their status. Increase the number of people living with HIV linked and retained in care. Improve the effectiveness of integrated TB/HIV service delivery. Strengthen CSO engagement in the national response. Increase domestic resource mobilization for the HIV response. Improve understanding of implementation effectiveness (what works and why through operational research). Improve evidence for planning
